title: Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces Clinical Coverage Policy: Group 2 Powered Mattress
content:
### Policy statement

A Group 2 powered mattress (the class's E0277 surface code) is furnished with a Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces bed on coverage only where the bed class permits a Group 2 powered mattress and the patient has:

- (a) multiple pressure ulcers of at least the class's lowest qualifying stage on the trunk or pelvis, after the class's required months on a Group 1 surface with a comprehensive ulcer program; or
- (b) large or multiple stage 3 or 4 ulcers; or
- (c) a flap or graft for such an ulcer within the past 60 days.

Continued need is documented at the class's documentation interval in months, and the surface is removed when the ulcers heal. A surface is added only once a prior-authorization request on this bed record is approved where the coverage class's prior-authorization requirement for beds and surfaces is Yes.

The class figures named here (whether the surface is permitted, its code, the lowest qualifying stage, the prior Group 1 months and the documentation interval) are the bed class's published surface values; the prior-authorization requirement belongs to the patient's coverage class in the Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records.

### Clinical criteria at a glance

| Route | What the patient presents | Further condition stated |
|---|---|---|
| (a) | Multiple pressure ulcers on the trunk or pelvis, at least the lowest qualifying stage | After the required months on a Group 1 surface with a comprehensive ulcer program |
| (b) | Large or multiple stage 3 or 4 ulcers | None stated |
| (c) | A flap or graft for such an ulcer | Within the past 60 days |

The three routes are alternatives joined by "or"; each is read together with the requirement that the bed class permits the surface.

### Prior authorization for adding the surface

| Coverage class requires prior authorization for beds and surfaces | Approved prior-authorization request on this bed record | The surface |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | This requirement is met |
| Yes | No | Is not added |
| No | — | This requirement places no condition on adding it |

The approval is read from the system record of requests attached to this bed record — the request's type, its status and the bed record it concerns — before the surface is added.

### Illustrations (hypothetical patients)

- A flap procedure for such an ulcer performed a hypothetical 40 days ago falls within the past 60 days; one performed a hypothetical 75 days ago does not.
- A patient with large stage 3 ulcers qualifies under route (b), which states no prior Group 1 period.
- A surface furnished under route (a) has its continued need documented at the class's documentation interval, and is removed when the ulcers heal.
